exercises.title: Construct the finite product topology
exercises.objective: Use the infimum of the two coordinate-induced topologies.
success: product is generated by coordinate induced topologies

exercises.title: Define basic open rectangles
exercises.objective: Test openness in both coordinate descriptions.

exercises.title: Define coordinate cylinders
exercises.objective: Restrict exactly one coordinate; finite intersections then restrict finitely many.

exercises.title: Distinguish product and box thinking
exercises.objective: Recognise a box condition on infinitely many coordinates.

checks.lean: example {ι α : Type*} (i : ι) (U : Set α) (f : ι → α) : f ∈ T11.Cylinder i U ↔ f i ∈ U := Iff.rfl
checks.message: A cylinder must depend only on coordinate `i`, not on every coordinate.

checks.lean: example (f : Nat → Bool) : f ∈ T11.allTrue ↔ ∀ n, f n = true := Iff.rfl
checks.message: The box example must require truth at all coordinates, not at just one coordinate.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} (τs : TopologicalSpace α) (τt : TopologicalSpace β) : @Continuous (α × β) α (T11.productTopology τs τt) τs Prod.fst := continuous_fst
checks.message: The first projection must be continuous for the constructed topology.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} (τs : TopologicalSpace α) (τt : TopologicalSpace β) : @Continuous (α × β) β (T11.productTopology τs τt) τt Prod.snd := continuous_snd
checks.message: The second projection must be continuous for the constructed topology.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} (τs : TopologicalSpace α) (τt : TopologicalSpace β) (U : Set α) (V : Set β) (hU : @IsOpen α τs U) (hV : @IsOpen β τt V) : @IsOpen (α × β) (T11.productTopology τs τt) (T11.Rectangle U V) := hU.prod hV
checks.message: An open rectangle must be open in the constructed product topology.

hints.hint: Use `TopologicalSpace.induced Prod.fst τs ⊓ TopologicalSpace.induced Prod.snd τt`.
Use `{f | ∀ n, f n = true}`; this is a box condition, not a finite-coordinate cylinder condition.
